text:
cecilia: Quick follow-up from last night's partial failures w/ model loads and cloud auth. We need a compact postmortem follow-up thread capturing owners, coverage windows, and recurrence assessment.

ben-r: Agree. PM logs say auth provider latency spikes roughly every 48-72h. Treat this as a recurring transient until we have a durable fix + vendor SLA updates.

tess: Current mitigations I see: rollback script for bad model manifests (tess), token cache with jittered TTL (tess), cross-region failover routing (oncall). Missing: an automated circuit breaker on model-load retries and improved alert classification.

infra-bot: Postmortem created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RINF-4601 — summary: "intermittent vendor auth latency led to partial model load failures".

oncall-ops: Please include columns in the tracker: primary, backup, backup_contact, coverage_window_utc, rotation_cadence, observed_interval_days. That will help handoffs.

cecilia: OK. Defaults: infra owners weekly, oncall daily during the 2-week runway. Also add a recurrence field (observed_interval_days).

ben-r: Proposed detection metric: p95_auth_latency over 30m moving window and a spike_count in 24h. If spike_count > 3 then auto-page SRE and enable fallback routing.

tess: I'll own cache smoothing + health probe (/health/auth). Plan: TTL jitter + exponential backoff on refresh and a small webhook for router. ETA: Fri EOD.

cecilia: Action items (please ack):
- Tess: healthcheck endpoint + cache smoothing + PR link (ETA Fri)
- Ben: alert rule + PD escalation mapping + metric definition (ETA Mon EOD)
- Oncall: add circuit-breaker config and runbook snippet; prefer degraded serving (smaller batch sizes + read-from-cache) over full fail-open (ETA Wed)
- Cecilia: update tracker with coverage columns + start daily digest for 14 days (ops-bot)

oncall-ops: Note: router should mark provider unhealthy after healthcheck fails 3 times in 5m, then route to fallback. Avoid cascading retries by limiting model-load concurrency when in degraded mode.

cecilia: Acked. I'll loop in legal/product for SLA review (roth@, legal@). If owners need help hitting ETAs ping me in-thread. :thumbsup:
